name: Piedmont Metalworks LLC
old_description: Established in 2007, Piedmont Metalworks LLC is a leading provider of custom and structural metal fabrication services for customers throughout North Carolina. With our expertise and dedication to excellence, we offer a wide range of premium-quality solutions, including MIG and TIG welding services.
about:
Piedmont Metalworks LLC operates from a 24,000-square-foot fabrication shop in Mebane, North Carolina. The company was established in 2007 and serves customers across central North Carolina from its location on US 70 West.

The shop provides custom and structural metal fabrication in stainless steel, aluminum, and carbon steel. Core processes include MIG and TIG welding, with the company describing its work as ranging from architectural panels to specialized components and sheets. No headcount or annual volume figures are published.

Piedmont Metalworks serves general contractors, electrical contractors, and mechanical contractors, along with clients in manufacturing, industrial, pharmaceutical, food service, and power generation sectors. Its service area includes cities such as Raleigh, Durham, Greensboro, Burlington, Cary, Chapel Hill, Apex, Fayetteville, High Point, Winston-Salem, Holly Springs, and Siler City.

The company emphasizes attention to detail, quality craftsmanship, and on-time delivery as the basis for its reputation. It offers free phone and on-site estimates and states it is fully licensed and insured.
